memories.content: The CEO knows Torchlight Media is shutting down permanently on the 14th. The all-hands meeting is scheduled for the 15th. The CEO has not decided whether to take questions at that meeting.
Torchlight Media is shutting down permanently on the 14th. An all-hands meeting is scheduled for the 15th. The CEO is expected to address employees at that meeting.
